description.html: The castle tower is an aquarium decoration shaped like two tall battlemented towers rising from a steep gray rock. Stairs climb up the rock, green moss details cover it, and there are openings and windows in the towers and rock. It looks like a fairy-tale fortress on a cliff.

The main advantage of this model is its shape: it is narrow and tall, so it takes up little space on the bottom while adding height to the setup. That makes it a good choice for smaller and taller aquariums, as well as for corners where a wider decoration would not fit. The openings serve as hiding places for small fish, and the tower pairs well with the other castles in our range if you want a themed aquarium.

Before placing it, rinse the tower in lukewarm water, without detergents. Because of its height, it is important that it stands firmly: place it on a flat bottom and press the base into the sand or gravel so larger fish cannot knock it over. It looks best in the back or a corner of the aquarium. Clean algae from the crevices with a soft brush during regular maintenance.
